controls.label: Reporting gap
controls.description: Simulated disruption: withhold reports for this many minutes, starting ten minutes after each approach begins. Reports resume after the fixed outage.

controls.label: Missing speed
controls.description: Simulated disruption: remove speed from this percentage of reports; retain positions and timestamps.

controls.label: Missing course
controls.description: Simulated disruption: remove course from this percentage of reports; retain positions and timestamps.

controls.label: Missing vessel class
controls.description: Simulated disruption: remove vessel type from this percentage of reports. Unknown remains distinct from cargo and tanker.

controls.label: Sensor drift
controls.description: Simulated disruption: smoothly bias reported speed in the selected direction, up to 0.1 knots per minute and a 3-knot bias at full strength. Positions and timestamps are preserved.

controls.label: Location drift
controls.description: Simulated disruption: gradually bias coordinates in a seeded direction, up to 20 metres per minute and 1,852 metres at full strength. Correction needs independently verified positions and trusted speed/course; optional simulated fixes add those reference assumptions.

controls.label: Sensor deterioration
controls.description: Simulated disruption: add Gaussian speed and course noise, up to standard deviations of 2 knots and 10 degrees at full strength.

controls.label: Position jump
controls.description: Simulated disruption: displace this percentage of position reports by a seeded Gaussian distance (2,000 m mean, 200 m standard deviation).

0.methodology: Daily summaries use all original five-minute checkpoints, with equal approach weight. Convergence uses disjoint five-minute bins; stability uses seven matched offsets.
0.coverage_note: Unavailable predictions remain in scheduled denominators and are omitted from error means.
0.caveat: Historical AIS and injected faults are exploratory; this comparison is not operational validation.

convergence.methodology: Approach-weighted five-minute bins by minutes to the recorded analytical crossing.
convergence.coverage_note: Unavailable predictions remain in scheduled denominators and are omitted from error means.
convergence.caveat: Historical AIS and injected faults are exploratory; this comparison is not operational validation.

sequence.methodology: Approach-weighted forecasts at 0–30 minutes from each approach’s first checkpoint.
sequence.coverage_note: Only complete sequences with all three models are included.

impact.methodology: Paired clean and selected forecasts at the same post-cutover checkpoints.

stability.methodology: Complete matched 30-minute sequences; spread is across observed approaches.
stability.coverage_note: Only approaches with all seven checkpoints and all three models are included.
